claim: Build has no pyramid, but in Gravesend's church (2026-11-17) a tower was made to end in a point: the apron on each face split at the face's centre line, each half hinged on that line with its parallax sky sloping down toward the corner, the corners mitred (six sectors for three street faces). Gables of 1.9 bodies on the 15.5-body tower read as a chimney or obelisk; at 3.9 bodies the far silhouette read as a church steeple, but from the tower's own foot the slope foreshortened flat and it read as a plain shaft.
evidence: projects/blood-city/experiments/church-skyline/README.md:44-47 and measurements.txt:2-3: round 2 six tower gables of 1.9 bodies on a 15.5-body apron, round 3 gables 3.9, ridge 17.4

critic-round2.md: 'obelisk' (vista_far), 'chimney or pillar' (avenue_south_up); critic-round3.md: 'Church steeple (certain as a silhouette)' (vista_far), 'a plain square shaft' (avenue_south_up), and :41-45 on the foreshortening from the foot
use: Use gables for the far silhouette only; the near read of a tower needs something at eye height.
